learnings.insight: renderToStaticMarkup often emits className before data-testid, so slicing html from the testid index misses the opening-tag classes (false fail on w-full).
learnings.action: When asserting classes on a testid node, walk back with lastIndexOf('<div'|'<section'…) to the tag start before checking class strings.
